overview: A wrapper around the HTML `<input type="text" />` element to provide styling. Use this component for plain, single-line text entry. If the use case calls for a more specific input type (search, password, email, number, etc.), prefer the corresponding component instead.

whenToUse: When collecting short, single-line free-text input from a user
When no more specific input variant (email, password, search, number, etc.) applies
do: Always pair with a visible label or accessible label attribute
Use the branded variant only in contexts that already use the branded palette (e.g. top navigation bar)
Supply action buttons only when they provide a single, clearly understood action
dont: Use this component for multi-line text entry
Rely on placeholder text as a substitute for a label
